articles.summary: Multi-head attention in Vision Transformers (ViTs) allows independent attention patterns across heads, but without explicit regularization, heads may learn redundant patterns rather than complementary roles. articles.title: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
articles.summary: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost. articles.summary: Agent decisions depend on empirical relationships that deployment observations reveal and task descriptions alone may leave unresolved.
